title: A Benchmark Protocol and Fairness Analysis Towards Open-Set EEG Seizure Type Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.27783v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated EEG seizure type classification systems are typically trained and evaluated under the closed-set assumption, where all seizure types encountered at deployment are seen during training. In clinical practice, this assumption fails: patients present with rare or atypical seizure types that fall outside the training label space, and a system that forces a wrong label is worse than one that abstains. We introduce the first open-set recognition protocol for EEG seizure type classification on the Temple University Hospital Seizure Corpus (TUSZ v2.0.3), defining known and unknown classes using the clinical taxonomy itself: seizure types with sufficient subject representation (at least 12 subjects) form the known set, and rare types form the unknown set. translated_title: 面向开放集脑电图癫痫发作类型分类的基准协议与公平性分析
translated_abstract: 自动脑电图（EEG）癫痫发作类型分类系统通常在闭集假设下进行训练和评估，即部署时遇到的所有癫痫发作类型在训练阶段均已见过的。在临床实践中，这一假设并不成立：患者可能出现训练标签空间之外的罕见或非典型发作类型，而一个强行给出错误标签的系统比一个选择弃权（拒识）的系统更糟糕。我们在天普大学医院癫痫语料库（TUSZ v2.0.3）上首次引入了针对脑电图癫痫发作类型分类的开放集识别协议，并利用临床分类体系本身来定义已知类与未知类：具有足够受试者代表性（至少12名受试者）的发作类型构成已知类集合，罕见类型构成未知类集合。我们在一个部分微调的脑电图基础模型（EFM）上评估了七种事后开放集评分方法（MSP、MaxLogit、energy、Mahalanobis、kNN、GHOST 和 COSTARR），并采用基于受试者的……
tldr: 该论文提出了首个基于 TUSZ 数据集的脑电图癫痫发作类型分类开放集识别基准协议，利用临床分类体系定义已知与未知发作类型，并在部分微调的脑电图基础模型上系统评估了七种开放集评分方法及其公平性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the first open-set recognition benchmark protocol for EEG seizure type classification on TUSZ, defining known and unknown seizure classes via the clinical taxonomy and systematically evaluating seven post-hoc open-set scorers applied to a partially fine-tuned EEG Foundation Model with a fairness analysis.
